prompt: Design a signup form with autofill, an async submit, a server-side duplicate-email error, interruption, and recovery. Optimize completion without hiding validation or inventing business rules.
assertions: Labels and input semantics support autofill and keyboard completion.
Validation timing, precise errors, pending, success, interruption, and recovery are explicit.
No business rule or product fact is invented.
Every check has status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; unsupported n/a and bare checkmarks fail the check.
Uses one authoritative self-check and preserves the field/state truth across three structurally, aesthetically, and vocally different runs.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (component-states) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
